caption:
The AI embedded a product demo video on the landing page. It shows up full width and about 150px tall, a thin strip nobody can watch.

Look at the card. An iframe has a default size of 300 by 150 pixels. width: 100% changes the width, but nothing tells the height to follow, so it stays at 150.

aspect-ratio: 16 / 9 with height: auto lets the browser work out the height from the width, at any screen size.

Before aspect-ratio we used a wrapper with padding-top: 56.25%. You can delete that hack now; every major browser supports the property.

Same fix for maps, Figma embeds and chart placeholders.

Source: MDN, aspect-ratio and <iframe> (width/height defaults).
